techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/src/voice.rs:59 The technique requires absent, broken and ready to be three states a client can tell apart. Here absent and broken share one Degraded variant, and only a free-text reason separates them.

pairs.registryProposal: speech-timing-timeline asks for one timing event per sentence, sent ahead of that sentence's first audio chunk, with times as sample offsets. This contract puts the per-sentence viseme spans inside the frame that carries the sentence's PCM, in ms relative to that sentence's audio. That meets the intent (audio clock, ordered with the audio, no wall-clock drift) by a route the technique does not list. It is worth naming as an accepted variant: whole-sentence frames that bundle audio and timeline, with ms as the unit when sample_rate travels alongside.
